subject.title: compaction: delivery-mirror usage poisons tokensBefore→null; assembler rejects the record, so sessions never truncate (safeguard thrash)

question: Which open compaction repair PR should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-backed, but three open closing PRs overlap with different repair depths; automation should not queue another fix or close the issue before maintainers pick or land a candidate.

options.title: Prefer the layered repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101033 as the canonical path if it adds adequate invalid-telemetry replay/truncation proof.

options.title: Land a narrower guard
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101018 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101047 if maintainers want a smaller consumer or producer-plus-consumer patch first.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open and close or revise the PRs if maintainers want a different compaction ownership boundary.
